rows.translation: La marge est le montant nécessaire pour maintenir une position de négociation ouverte. rows.english: There is also an important terminology distinction. An “equity trading account” commonly means a brokerage account used to trade company shares. Equity in a trading account means the live account value after the unrealized results of open forex or CFD positions are included.
